title: SizlandWallet
description: SizlandWallet is your sovereign identity stack—client-side, private, non-custodial, and censorship-resistant, generated on your device and never held by us. One cryptographic identity maps to addresses across multiple chains, with seamless rotation if compromised. Work history is stored as signed credentials on permanent, user-owned logs (SizChain X), so your reputation persists even if the platform goes offline.
